option.enderscape.elytra_add_fov_effects: When enabled, gliding with the Elytra will influence your FOV.
option.enderscape.elytra_add_gliding_sou:
When enabled, gliding with the Elytra will play a new gliding sound.

Other players will also be able to hear it from afar!
option.enderscape.elytra_add_open_close_: Elytra: Add open and close sounds
When enabled, opening and closing your elytra will play new sounds.
option.enderscape.elytra_sneak_to_stop_g: When enabled, pressing the sneak key allows you to instantly stop gliding.
option.enderscape.elytra_update_equip_so: When enabled, Elytra will have a unique sound upon equipping.
option.enderscape.end_portal_update_part: When enabled, End Portals will have unique particles.
option.enderscape.end_portal_update_trav: When enabled, there will be a unique sound for travelling to the End.
option.enderscape.ender_pearl_add_partic: When enabled, Ender Pearls will create portal particles when flying through the air.
option.enderscape.ender_pearl_break_part: When enabled, Ender Pearls will create breaking particles like Eggs when hitting the ground.
option.enderscape.ender_pearl_update_tel: When enabled, Ender Pearls' teleporting sound will be updated.
option.enderscape.ender_pearl_update_thr: When enabled, Ender Pearls will have a unique throwing sound.
option.enderscape.enderman_static_overla: When enabled, staring at an Enderman will make your vision increasingly distorted.
When enabled, staring at an Enderman will make your hearing increasingly distorted.
option.enderscape.enderman_stereo_stare_:
When enabled, Endermen stare sounds will be tied to the player that they are angry at.

When the Enderman is defeated or their anger quelled, the sound will quickly fade.
option.enderscape.endermite_emissive_eye: When enabled, Endermite eyes will be emissive.
option.enderscape.endermite_expand_hit_r: When enabled, Endermites will be easier to hit.
option.enderscape.endermite_update_sound: When enabled, Endermites will have unique sounds.
option.enderscape.flash_enabled.desc:
§eEnables End Flashes, added in 1.21.9.§r

Occasionally, a bright flash will appear in the End's sky.
option.enderscape.flash_frequency.desc: End flash frequency in minutes. (0.5 would be 30 seconds)
option.enderscape.flash_influences_skybo:
§eRequires enabling Skybox Update!§r

When enabled, End flashes will darken the sky.
When enabled, End flashes will have a new texture and biome-specific coloration.
option.enderscape.lighting_style.desc:
Choose between different lighting styles.

Vanilla: Unchanged.

Improved: Darker and moodier.

Midnight: Very dark and moody.
option.enderscape.mirror_screen_effect_e: When enabled, teleporting with a Mirror will display a unique screen effect.
option.enderscape.mirror_tooltip_display: Displays the coordinates of the block the Mirror is linked to.
Displays the dimension of the block the Mirror is linked to.
Displays the approximate distance to the block the Mirror is linked to.
option.enderscape.mirror_tooltip_enabled: Mirror: Display linked info in tooltip
Display information about the block the Mirror is linked to.
option.enderscape.mirror_tooltip_shift_t: Mirror: Press SHIFT to display tooltip

Maybe you'd prefer not to show where your Mirror leads to...

When enabled, hold SHIFT to see your Mirror's linked block information.
option.enderscape.nebulite_tool_hud_enab: Se abilitato, tenendo in mano uno strumento di Nebulite (es. Specchio, Attrattore di Magnia) viene mostrato un elemento HUD sopra il mirino con l'energia attuale e il costo di utilizzo.
option.enderscape.portal_particle_emissi: Makes Nether Portal, Enderman, Ender Chest, and related particles emissive.
option.enderscape.rubblemite_expand_hit_: When enabled, Rubblemites will be easier to hit.
option.enderscape.shulker_bullet_enforce: The maximum amount of Shulker Bullets a Shulker can have at once. Disabled when set to 0.
The maximum distance between Shulker Bullets and their target before disappearing. Disabled when set to 0.
When enabled, Shulker Bullets will disappear when their owner dies.
The time limit in seconds before a Shulker Bullet disappears. Disabled when set to 0.
option.enderscape.shulker_bullet_loop_so: When enabled, Shulker Bullets play a new sound while moving.
option.enderscape.shulker_bullet_rebalan: When enabled, Shulker Bullets inflict stronger but shorter Levitation on players they hit.
option.enderscape.shulker_hurt_by_pierci: Shulker: Hurt by piercing when closed
When enabled, Shulkers will be hurt by arrows with piercing even when their shells are closed.
option.enderscape.silverfish_expand_hit_: When enabled, Silverfish will be easier to hit.
option.enderscape.skybox_add_dynamic_fog: Skybox Update: Add dynamic fog density

Adds dynamic fog density to the End depending on what biome you're in.

May possibly conflict with other mods.
option.enderscape.skybox_scales_brightne:
Adjusts skybox brightness by a percentage of game brightness.

Designed to alleviate visibility issues. Changing this option drastically could look bad.
Updates the End skybox to be more interesting and dynamic.

The updated skybox features subtle stars and nebulae throughout, as well as the ability to change color between biomes.
option.enderscape.structure_music_fading:
When enabled, entering a structure will fade out biome music to play its unique music. Exiting the structure will fade away its music as well.

Currently supports End Cities.
option.enderscape.tridents_return_from_v: When enabled, Tridents with the Loyalty enchantment return to you after hitting the void instead of disappearing forever.
option.enderscape.void_poof_particles_up: When enabled, Endermen, Endermites, and Rubblemites will emit black cloud particles upon death.
